question: The Nubra, Shyok and Hunza are tributaries of the river __________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Indus**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The Nubra, Shyok, and Hunza are tributaries of the river **Indus**.
 
• The Indus River is one of the longest rivers in the world, flowing through China, India, and Pakistan.
 
• It plays a crucial role in the agriculture and economy of the regions it flows through, especially in Pak
